endpoints.master: Vision (192.168.10.1 isolated), Python codec harness, not pydnp3
endpoints.outstation: SEL-751A 192.168.10.7:20000 via the relay leg dp64
endpoints.switch: Tofino-1, pre-test program rrc_bor_build_v2 must be restored after the run

failure_outcomes.bypassed: unsupported or busy request forwarded unchanged
failure_outcomes.fallback: watchdog release, reported with its reason counter
failure_outcomes.late: response after the hold horizon, kept in the population
failure_outcomes.missing: no response within the application budget
failure_outcomes.rejected: admission refused the point; not collected

observation_points: relay-facing capture only if a supported tap exists (otherwise stated and conclusions restricted)

tolerances.rule: applied separately to verified early and late arrivals; insufficient coverage is reported, not hidden
